description: Données Ouvertes sur les Gares Ferroviaires - Bâtiments au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Transports. Les données sur les bâtiments des gares ferroviaires, classées par leur position, fournissent des informations essentielles sur les infrastructures physiques qui soutiennent le fonctionnement et le développement du réseau ferroviaire. Ces bâtiments jouent un rôle central dans l'accueil des passagers, la gestion des marchandises, et les opérations ferroviaires. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Transports. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
